items.exampleEn: Knock lightly on the door; the baby is sleeping.
items.exampleZh: 輕輕地敲門，寶寶在睡覺。

items.exampleEn: Don't walk on the hot sand with bare feet.
items.exampleZh: 別赤著腳走在滾燙的沙子上。

items.exampleEn: There are many curves on the mountain road.
Let me explain the essence of the plan in one sentence.
items.exampleZh: 讓我用一句話說明這個計畫的精髓。

items.exampleEn: This building is in a classical style.
That restaurant is too flash for a family dinner.
items.exampleZh: 那家餐廳太浮華了，全家聚餐不太適合。
items.glossZh: 浮華的（英式口語）；炫目的

items.exampleEn: She wore a plain white dress.
items.exampleZh: 她穿著一件樸素的白色洋裝。

items.exampleEn: With so many cars on the road, traffic jams are inevitable.
items.exampleZh: 路上車子這麼多，塞車是不可避免的。

items.audioEn: Go around the big curve, and you'll see the museum on your right.
items.audioZh: 繞過大彎道，就會看到博物館在你的右手邊。
options: At the end of the road
Next to the big curve on the left
On the right after the curve

items.sentenceEn: The trees are bare in winter.
Some changes in life are inevitable.
items.sentenceZh: 人生中有些改變是不可避免的。

items.stemEn: The cupboard was ____: there was no food at all.
items.stemZh: 櫥櫃空空的，一點食物都沒有。

items.stemEn: Students in this school study ____ dance and modern dance.
items.stemZh: 這所學校的學生學古典舞和現代舞。

items.passageEn: My aunt is a piano teacher who loves classical music. Her house is very plain: white walls, bare floors, and almost no furniture. She says the essence of music is listening, not buying a flash piano. Last week, she played a piece for me. Her fingers touched the keys lightly, and the music rose and fell like a gentle curve. She told me that making mistakes is inevitable, so I shouldn't be afraid to try. She has helped me overcome my fear of playing in front of others.
items.passageZh: 我阿姨是一位熱愛古典音樂的鋼琴老師。她的家很樸素：白色的牆、光禿禿的地板，幾乎沒有家具。她說音樂的本質是聆聽，不是買一台浮華的鋼琴。上週她為我彈了一首曲子。她的手指輕輕地碰觸琴鍵，音樂像一條柔和的曲線般起伏。她告訴我，犯錯是不可避免的，所以我不該害怕嘗試。她幫助我克服了在別人面前彈琴的恐懼。

options: 掛滿了各種古典樂器和照片

questions.questionZh: 阿姨說為什麼不該害怕嘗試？
options: 因為犯錯本來就是不可避免的

items.promptZh: 這本書是用淺白的英文寫的。
referenceEn: This book is written in plain English.
This book was written in plain English.
rubricZh: plain 表示「淺白的、樸素的」，例如 plain English 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 因為天氣變了，改變計畫是不可避免的。
referenceEn: Because the weather changed, a change of plan was inevitable.
A change of plan was inevitable because the weather changed.
rubricZh: 用 inevitable 表示「不可避免的」
